description: Public Utility Commission of Texas - Water and Sewer Submetering or Allocation is a dataset listed in State of Texas open data portal (data.texas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Texas. Submetered utility service is water utility service that is master metered for the owner by the retail public utility and individually metered by the owner at each dwelling unit; wastewater utility service based on submetered water utility service; water utility service measured by point-of-use submeters when all of the water used in a dwelling unit ... Coverage: Texas. Its tags are water utilities, public utility commission of texas. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: PUC Consumer Protection. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-texas-gov-portal.
